description: After payment, use the delivery token to list files or read rows. Use json, csv, xlsx, fields.json, or rows pages; a paid excess-rows add-on has its own extra.json, extra.csv, extra.xlsx and extra.fields.json. XLSX is returned as base64 bytes with its content type. All rows pages for a file count once per token; a full download counts once each. On expiry or download_limit, call get_order with your order capability for a fresh token. A current session is required and the delivery token is bound to it. If the original session expired, initialize a new one and call get_order first.

order_id.description: Order number, e.g. GMD7K3P9Q. Lowercase or hyphenated input (gmd-7k3p9q) is accepted.
